name: Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling - Rancho Cucamonga Bottling & Distribution Center, CA

fieldNotes.status: FACILITY UNDER ACTIVE DEMOLITION AND RECONSTRUCTION. Multiple 2026 news sources (Reyes Coca-Cola newsroom, IE Business Daily, PRNewswire, BeverageDaily) confirm Reyes Coca-Cola broke ground in February 2026 on a full demolition-and-rebuild of the existing 125,000 sq ft 1984 distribution building at 10670 6th St, replacing it with a 620,000+ sq ft production+distribution campus occupying about one city block. Construction runs through 2027; operations are temporarily relocated to Fontana, CA during construction. The auditable, stable operating yard does not currently exist.
fieldNotes.location: Roster supplied 11251 6th St and coords 34.084,-117.559; the correct address per the Rancho Cucamonga Chamber, Waze and multiple directories is 10670 6th St, Rancho Cucamonga, CA 91730. 6th St was confirmed via Street View as a 4-lane divided arterial running E-W through the industrial district north of Ontario Mills, ~lat 34.0845. 10670 is east of Milliken Ave (-117.5555). The exact parcel could not be unambiguously identified within the dense 6th St warehouse corridor - no Coca-Cola signage or a clearly-imaged demolition site was resolvable, and current 2026 satellite imagery still shows intact warehouses (likely captured before demolition).
fieldNotes.coords: Best-estimate parcel center 34.0824,-117.5530 (6th St corridor, ~1 block east of Milliken Ave) - NOT confirmed. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Estimated one-city-block footprint per news ('takes up about one city block', 620,000+ sq ft) - dimensions are an estimate, not measured from a confirmed parcel.
fieldNotes.classification: All physical-layout flags left false/null because the facility is mid-demolition - no stable docks, gate, guard booth, or yard exist to classify. The new campus design (per news) will include 4 production lines, a parking garage, EV charging, and a recycling center - but as-built layout is unknown.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - dense Inland Empire industrial fabric of Rancho Cucamonga, adjacent to I-15 and Ontario Mills.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Re-audit after facility completion (expected 2027) when the new 620,000 sq ft campus is operational.

citations.claim: Reyes operates the Rancho Cucamonga distribution facility (10670 6th St), expanding to a 620,000 sq ft production+distribution campus

verification.rationale: Reyes Coca-Cola Bottling-operated site; currently a DC mid-rebuild into a production campus (ops temporarily relocated to Fontana during 2025-2027 construction). Still a Reyes yard.
